title: crumbkit/self-figures-list/v1
description: The figures of each command in the usage log, and a summary of the runs read.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page.

caller.description: The coding agent's id, such as claude-code, person or unknown.

FiguresRow.description: The figures of one command in the usage log.

command.description:
The command path below the tool's name, such as `books show`, or the
tool's name for its root command.

help_before.description:
The help pages that each run's session read since its last run
that printed no help page, summed over the runs.

help_pages.description: The runs that printed the command's help page.

p95_ms.description:
The 95th percentile of the runs' wall time in milliseconds, or null
when every run printed help.

p95_out_bytes.description:
The 95th percentile of the bytes that the runs wrote to standard
output, or null when no run printed a result.

refused.description: The runs whose command line was refused.

runs.description: The runs that did not print a help page.

UsageSummary.description:
The summary of the runs that `self usage` read. The text output prints
it as one line above the table, such as `1,284 runs in 23 sessions since
30 Sep: claude-code 1,201, person 83.`

callers.description: The runs of each caller, the most first.

runs.description: The runs that the report read.

sessions.description: The sessions that the runs came from.

since.description: The day in UTC on which the report starts, such as 2026-09-30.

skipped.description:
The records that the report left out, because they named a command,
flag, code or caller that the tool does not write.
